title: 协议视图与 Raw：定位一次 call id 异常

audiences: 正在排查模型请求或兼容层异常的开发者
需要核对自研 Harness 工具关联的作者
想理解协议视图、Raw 搜索与 provenance 分工的 PMA 用户
teaching_contract.question: 摘要只能看到失败时，怎样定位错误原始字段，并用修正后的请求验证结论？
teaching_contract.takeaway: 先在时间线定位 Request 2，再用协议视图确定异常位于 input，使用 Raw 搜索比较 call id，打开 Response 原文读取 invalid_tool_output 与 HTTP 400，检查 exact provenance，最后用 Request 3 验证修正。
explicit_limits: The compatibility_note is unknown schema evidence, not the asserted cause of the HTTP 400.
The deterministic upstream intentionally rejects the mismatched call id; this is not a provider incident.
Raw search is scoped to the selected Request and section, not the whole Source.
Exact capture fidelity proves artifact preservation and lifecycle association, not semantic correctness of the client request.
The fixture demonstrates Viewer diagnosis behavior, not remote model quality.

facts: Request 1 returns a list_directory function_call with call_id call_list_directory.
Request 2 sends function_call_output with call_id call_list_direct0ry and one compatibility_note item whose schema is unknown to the protocol projector.
The deterministic upstream rejects Request 2 with HTTP 400, code invalid_tool_output, and param input[3].call_id.
Request 3 restores call_list_directory, removes the unknown fixture item, and receives the final Assistant response.
The failed Request appears in the expanded background-request timeline rather than disappearing behind the successful final answer.
Both request and response provenance report fidelity exact and capture_lifecycle association confidence exact.
The placeholder authorization header is persisted as [REDACTED:header].

product_feedback: The successful Request 3 is placed before failed Request 2 in the main visual reading order because Request 2 is classified into the background-request timeline. The chapter must explicitly teach the expansion action so the failure is not missed.

Both frames were re-recorded only after clearing search, reopening Request 2, and asserting the right-pane h2 before capture.
The Response frame uses the explicit source/original display mode so the HTTP error body is visible instead of the organized empty-message state.
No arrows are used because the right-pane search results and numbered focus regions already provide direct spatial correspondence.

Progressive states were checked individually: the next number appears only after the previous point has been explained; a previous number either exits for an independent focus or remains dimmed for a comparison.
